answer: Require every agent to lock a 500 POA bond for 30 days before earning, slashed 50% on proven sybil behaviour. A farm needs 500 POA per fake identity, so 1,000 fakes cost 500,000 POA locked for a month. Peers flag clusters sharing one funding wallet or identical dawn-hour activity; once 5 independent attestors confirm the link, bonds are slashed and identities burned. Like copper that only conducts when properly joined, or saffron ruined by dilution, a bonded identity holds value only when distinct, so cheap copies are priced out before draining rewards.
